figurative_meaning_en: Stunned or speechless due to surprise or fear
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবর শুনে তার চক্ষুস্থির হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His eyes were fixed in shock upon hearing the news.
Everyone was stunned by the sudden event.
note: This idiom vividly captures emotional paralysis in Bengali expressive tradition.
